company.name: Synch
company.shortDescription: Synch provides a range of smart inventory and ordering solutions.
company.description:
Synch provides a range of smart inventory and ordering solutions. The company’s solution portfolio includes a smart phone application and a web dashboard. The smart phone application helps users capture their orders and manage their inventories on the move without paper and pencil. Statistics and analytics are presented on web dashboards as well as in the app to help users with their master demand planning and decisions

Synch was founded by Changhao Han and Scott Dyer, and is based in Toronto, Ohio.
